sample.task:
(In the clubroom…)

Monika: “Hang on…where’s Natsuki?”

Sayori: “You’re right, Monika! She hasn’t shown up yet! Yuri, can you give her a call?”

Yuri: “Of course, I’ll try calling her right now.”

(Yuri dials Natsuki’s number and waits for her to answer.)

(Natsuki’s phone starts ringing, but there’s no response.)

Yuri: “Hmm, she’s not picking up. Maybe she’s just running a little late?”

Monika: “I hope so. It would be strange for Natsuki to miss a club meeting without letting anyone know.”

Sayori: “Yeah, she’s usually really punctual. I hope nothing’s wrong.”

Yuri: “I’ll try sending her a text message then. Maybe she just didn’t hear her phone ringing.”

(Yuri sends a text to Natsuki, asking if she’s okay and if she’s coming to the club meeting.)

Monika: “Let’s give her a few more minutes. Maybe she’s just caught up with something and couldn’t make it on time.”

(They wait a few more minutes, but there’s still no sign of Natsuki.)

Yuri: “I’m starting to get a little worried now. What if something happened to her?”

(Just then, Sayori’s phone buzzes with a message from Natsuki. It was a video of Natsuki feeling the kicks of her unborn daughter - Sakura. Below the video was Natsuki’s text.)
sample.chosen:
Natsuki: "Sorry for the late notice, but I won't be able to make it to the club meeting today. I'm feeling some strong kicks from Sakura, and I think it's best if I rest for a bit. I hope you all understand. See you next time!"

Monika: "Aww, poor Natsuki. I hope she's feeling better soon. It's amazing how she's already feeling her baby's kicks!"

Sayori: "Yeah, it's so exciting! I can't wait to meet Sakura. Let's make sure to give Natsuki some extra support and encouragement during this time."

Yuri: "Absolutely, she deserves all the love and care we can give her. Let's send her a message to let her know we're thinking of her and wishing her well."

(They all send Natsuki messages of support and encouragement, eagerly awaiting the day they can meet the newest addition to their club family.)
